gap_records.detail: Current consolidated legal text and mission guidance must be checked for the case date; this module uses scoped official-source notes, not full legislative PDF bytes.
Specific reach of Forvaltningslag provisions to consular visa functions, interaction with Visa Code and Directive 2004/38 requires legal analysis, not automatic promotion.
A three-week ordinary appeal period is published; receipt, procedural exceptions and any special rules must be verified before calculating a last day.

operational_records.description: Swedish Istanbul mission offers direct appointment requests to qualifying EU family members, alternatively VFS; the mission says applicants should email and eligibility is checked before appointment.
EU-family visa fee is exempt for qualifying applicants; VFS publishes separate EUR 14 service fee. Assess if VFS was a choice or a mandate.
Consular guidance says Turkish family-book extract OR other evidence of family ties; assess probative value, authentication and translation separately.
JO can investigate public-administration conduct but cannot annul visas; submissions generally become public records; ordinary appeal limits remain separate.

rule_records.proposition: Swedish law recognises derived residence of defined family members of qualifying EEA citizens, subject to right-of-residence conditions.
rule_records.support_scope: Chapter 3a sections 2-4; review actual facts, Union citizen status, and statutory exceptions.

rule_records.proposition: A qualifying non-EEA family member must apply for a residence card following arrival; Migrationsverket issues it if statutory conditions met.
rule_records.support_scope: Chapter 3a sections 10 and 12a and residence-card guidance; distinct from entry visa.

rule_records.proposition: Swedish administrative authorities are subject to legal basis, impartiality, proportionality, accessibility and service principles.
rule_records.support_scope: Forvaltningslag sections 4-9, applicability and lex-specialis exceptions must be checked for consular visa handling.

rule_records.proposition: Party access and opportunity to comment on material can be relevant, with statutory exceptions and secrecy safeguards.
rule_records.support_scope: Forvaltningslag sections 10 and 25; cannot generalise to all visa materials or overlook secrecy laws and EU safeguards.

rule_records.proposition: An authority anticipating significant delay in an individually initiated case generally must notify the party and state the reason.
rule_records.support_scope: Forvaltningslag section 11, subject to section 4 lex specialis and applicability checks; six-month section 12 mechanism not presented as visa deadline.

rule_records.proposition: Swedish administrative decisions significantly affecting a person normally need reasons and appeal information unless an exception or special provision applies.
rule_records.support_scope: Forvaltningslag sections 32-33 and special aliens law, not automatic conclusion for each visa case.
